description: One thing a removal reaches, said to be going or said to be kept.

bytes.description:
What it occupies, where that is knowable. Absent for a container or a network,
whose room is the image's rather than their own.

kept.description:
Why it is being kept rather than removed, where it is being kept.

`None` is the ordinary case: this line is going. A reason here is the whole of
how an image shared with another project, or a path this run could not
confirm, stays on the list without being taken.

name.description: What it is called — a container name, an image reference, or a full path.

secret.description: Whether it holds a credential, so a report can say what destroying it destroys.

sort.description: Which of the four sorts of thing it is.

what.description: What it is, in the operator's words.
